cohort: A 27-year-old pregnant woman diagnosed with chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) at 10-week gestation, who developed severe dyspnea on exertion due to hyperleukocytosis.
finding: Therapeutic leukapheresis effectively reduced white blood cell count and significantly improved both subjective dyspnea and objective physiological respiratory measurements in a pregnant woman with CML.
mod_finding: The woman gave birth by elective caesarean section at 32 weeks gestation.
